source_review.F13: Full Function/CallBase AttributeList values and recursive function/instruction metadata are encoded by stable current instruction ordinal. Attached/trailing debug records, metadata operands, local metadata references and unrepresented constant owners are rejected before subject/incoming-caller projection admission. Prior explicit ordered local uses, hidden BlockAddress checks, BB/VST hidden state and complete current output comparison remain.

header_renderer.default_behavior: Private mode flags default false, enabled only at the new fixed LLVM export. Original default TypeFinder/SlotTracker/use-order/body printing code remains selected outside that mode. The original normal use-order algorithm is retained when splitting the header-specific orderer.
header_renderer.current_dependencies: Dedicated official AsmWriter mode serializes actual current headers plus global initializers, aliases, ifuncs, types reachable from headers, linkage/DSO state/comdat/attrs, personality/prefix/prologue, global/function/named metadata and header-value order. It does not construct cloned functions or visit body instructions for slots/types in the direct path.
header_renderer.owner_rejection: Recursive header validator rejects BlockAddress/body locals/unrepresented metadata before writing. The supported path is not permission to ignore body-owned dependencies.
header_renderer.fallback: Missing/rejected renderer now prints complete actual current Module including bodies. It no longer uses strip-body CloneModule on the unsupported-owner path, so current unsupported body references do not collapse into an empty/partial key. Actual worldText-level mutation counterexample requires two fallbacks/zero directs and different nonempty keys. Incoming caller full projection remains independently appended.
header_renderer.limit: Header dependency projection still traverses current global/header inventories each use, and concatenates complete world/key bytes. It is not global LLVM optimization reuse or O(1) whole-module work.

TLI_memo.binding: Actual registered typed TargetLibraryAnalysis owns the once-initialized private baseline. SDK getter verifies exact current cached Info.Impl association to that baseline before lending its address as an immutable identity. A result storage address is never a token; a foreign mutable Impl forces original full projection.
TLI_memo.mutable_state: Every consumer re-reads complete current unavailable-override words and five ABI scalar queries. Exact basis/words/scalars match reuses the original full all-LibFunc availability/name bytes; dynamic no-builtins/setUnavailable mutations cannot be hidden.
TLI_memo.lifetime: Request-private non-copyable memo is absent from resident Products. Actual Rust compile_input has one LLVMRunPasses/FAM lifecycle. Manager change, leaving phase1/reentering it, and request termination clear borrowed tokens; counters survive clear. Any future extra RunPasses boundary must maintain this rule.
TLI_memo.bounds: 32 entries/4MiB logical scratch only; cap or missing helper executes full current projection. No language quota is renewed and no new analysis domain admitted.
TLI_memo.tests: Real current factory/result override, AM.clear, no-builtin attributes, foreign Impl mutation, new baseline/name/factory, explicit lifetime clear and bounded admission all compare memo bytes with original full current facts.

compact_operands.losslessness: 16B trivial tag/payload/extra record retains full32-bit register and subregister, all original register flags, all nonreg target flags, signed64 immediate bits via memcpy, and current MBB ordinal. The pool contains owned APInt values, not LLVM owners.
compact_operands.pool_validation: Widths and all high bits participate in equality. Before allocating body, each CImm index must be the next encounter index and every pool element used once; dangling/reordered/aliased/unused references reject. Default unknown tag rejects.
compact_operands.capacity: Only actual pool APInt inline values and >64-bit allocated words are charged; no dummy APInt/word per ordinary operand. Snapshot accounts for the pool vector object once. Existing optional caps, language budgets, exact raw probabilities, current owner rebinding, typed/MIR equality, MachineVerifier and final AsmPrinter are preserved.
compact_operands.validation: Unchanged255 scratch mask now exercises signed64 extrema,1/65/129/257-bit integers, width/highbit differences, bad/aliased/unused pool indices and real logical capacity-ledger deltas. This reduces optional retained payload; not an RSS or speed proof.

four_observers.actual_calls: Both FPM and both MIR world construction/comparison call sites pass Request Stats. Direct/fallback increments reflect actual helper outcomes. copyStats obtains actual cumulative memo build/reuse counts even after lifetime clear. Finish and Abort preserve first-hooked-attempt scope.
four_observers.abi: C++26u64 size/offset asserts match Rust reprC26-field WireStats and conversions; new fields occupy offsets22..25. JSON observer_schema2 explicitly emits all four.
four_observers.schema: Validator requires nonnegative non-bool integer values for schema2 and rejects unknown schemas. Legacy schema1 keeps absent new observations unknown, never fabricated zero. Exact current36-test log/exit is bound below.
four_observers.scope: Counts do not cover unhooked fresh-context retry work; total native timings and wall still include it. They do not establish zero aggregate allocations or zero complete-output work.
